question: For which franchise has Dewald Brevis made his debut in the fifteenth edition of the IPL?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mumbai Indians**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Dewald Brevis made his debut in the **fifteenth edition of the IPL (IPL 2022)** for the **Mumbai Indians**.
 
• Dewald Brevis, a South African cricketer, earned the nickname "Baby AB" due to his batting style, which resembles that of AB de Villiers.
 
• He gained attention for his remarkable performances in the **2022 ICC U-19 Cricket World Cup**, where he was the tournament's leading run-scorer, amassing 506 runs.
 
• His aggressive batting style and ability to hit big shots caught the eye of IPL franchises.
 
• During the **IPL 2022 Auction**, Dewald Brevis was bought by the **Mumbai Indians** for INR 3 crore.
 
• This marked his debut in the IPL. Despite being a newcomer, Brevis showcased his potential with a fearless approach, making an impression in the matches he played.
